messages:
incident-bot: Paging: high error rate detected for /v1/generate from hosted-us-east-1 (P2). @oncall-alex please acknowledge and start triage.

oncall-alex: ack. looking at traffic now. seeing 5xx spike starting ~00:10 UTC. customer impact?

sre-maria: reporting from alerts: 5xx rate up to 18% for gen route, latency p95 up ~2x. Not all tenants affected, looks region-specific.

eng-kevin: on it. do we have request ids or sample logs?

oncall-alex: @eng-kevin I can paste a couple sample request ids. But quick note: observability dashboards for streaming agents seem to show "ingest sampling: 10%" in the front end lately. not sure if sampling changed during deployment.

incident-bot: Deployment detected: dedicated/runtime v3.4.1 rolled to hosted-us-east-1 at 1958398800 by eng-kevin.

pd-tess: can we assess customer-visible impact? Which customers are erroring?

oncall-alex: customer list from error logs (partial): acme-inc, shoply, quicknote. I'll DM SOC for escalation.

eng-kevin: grabbing logs. quick query: `index=prod logs route=/v1/generate | where status>=500 | sort by timestamp desc | limit 50`

obs-eli: heads-up: that index is sampled for high-volume routes. if sampling changed we may be missing early timeline events. I can run a raw ingest query but might be slow.

ops-jen: noticed we changed log-sampling config in yesterday's deploy for cost reasons: `logging.sampling.rate: 0.1` for generate route. That would explain gaps.

oncall-alex: ugh. so we might not have full trace of when error started. Need alternative sources: request traces, metric timelines, kube events.

eng-kevin: I found this request id from a 500: rId=0a3f2b4d. Error message: `runtime-alloc error: failed to pin model shard`. copying snippet: ```error=\"failed to allocate device memory\" mem_needed=234MB avail=96MB```

sre-maria: that points at out-of-memory on a GPU; could be runtime resource pressure rather than routing. Any concurrent scale events?

incident-bot: Autoscaler event: pool-hosted-gpu scaled down by 1 at 1958398700 (scale policy: conserve).

eng-kevin: scale-down happened ~10m before errors. If scale-down reduced capacity and we evicted models, that could trigger alloc failures.

pd-tess: customer impact severity: several mid-tier customers with synchronous requests. We should enable a mitigation for now.

oncall-alex: mitigation plan: 1) revert low-priority scale-down (ops-jen) 2) enable fallback model variant (kevin) 3) increase log sampling temporarily (eli) 4) contact customers (tess). Who can flip sampling?

obs-eli: I can bump sampling to 100% for the affected route via `obsctl sampling set --route /v1/generate --rate 1.0` but need approval. Doing it now.

ops-jen: reverting scale-down now (manual override). patching autoscaler to hold +1 replica.

eng-kevin: initiating fallback: routing policy for hosted-us-east-1 updated to prefer quantized-variant when runtime error occurs. pushing config: ```routes.v1.generate.fallback=[quantized-1b, quantized-2b]```

oncall-alex: after fallback push I'm still seeing errors on ~25% of requests but overall 5xx rate trending down from 18% -> 6% in last 3m.

incident-bot: Note: logs for 1958398500-1958399000 may be incomplete due to sampling. obs-eli increased sampling at 1958400200.

sre-maria: we need to build a timeline. earliest detected error ~1958399400 in metrics but sparse logs until 1958400200 when sampling increased. Add checks: kube events, autoscaler, deploy, disk/GPU metrics.

eng-kevin: adding my hypothesis: scale-down evicted model shards; subsequent cold start + memory pressure caused OOMs. fallback mitigated some calls but cold-starts still cause failures.

ops-jen: from node metrics: gpu memory pressure spiked at 1958399300, and a pod OOM kill recorded at 1958399365.

pd-tess: I'll draft customer comms: one-liner + mitigation + ETA for full fix. putting in #support to coordinate.

oncall-alex: question: why didn't autoscaler respect minimum capacity? policy shows min_replicas=2 but we dipped to 1 at 1958398700. looking at policy history.

obs-eli: preliminary: controller had a stale cache and interpreted desired=1 during a rolling update. That's a separate bug. we should open follow-up.

sre-maria: for RCA we'll need exact trace samples for impacted requests. obs-eli — can you export the sampled logs we have since bump? include raw request bodies stripped of PII.

obs-eli: exporting now. query used: ```raw_index=prod_raw | where route==\"/v1/generate\" and timestamp >= 1958399000 | fields timestamp, request_id, status, node_id, mem_used```. output will be uploaded to the incident drive.

eng-kevin: also attaching runtime logs from node-07 where OOMs occurred. snippet: ```[1958399365] pod=model-server-07 OOMKill: process killed due to memory limit```

incident-bot: oncall rotation: handoff scheduled at 1958400600 from oncall-alex -> oncall-sam. oncall-alex please include current mitigation state and pending actions.

oncall-alex: acking handoff notes: mitigation in place (scale override, fallback routing, sampling increased). remaining: fully restore autoscaler cache, investigate controller bug, follow up on model eviction behavior, monitor p95. handing to oncall-sam. tagging @oncall-sam in thread.

eng-kevin: postmortem action items: 1) fix autoscaler cache bug (eng-platform) 2) make fallback routing automatic on OOMs 3) add alert for unexpected scale below min_replicas 4) ensure logs are not over-sampled for short windows (obs).

pd-tess: customer update drafted and sent to impacted customers. will update with timeline when RCA ready.

sre-maria: next steps: collect final artifacts (raw logs, kube events, autoscaler history, deploy manifests). I'll own timeline and hypothesis list. Putting tasks into the incident board.

oncall-alex: thanks team. monitoring closely. if errors spike back to >10% we will re-open page. :railway_track:

ops-jen: note for ops: we should consider temporary capacity buffer during canary windows. adding to agenda. :memo:

obs-eli: export complete: https://drive.internal/reports/incident-1958400123/raw-logs.zip (permissions set for incident channel).

sre-maria: closing in-thread timeline update for now. leaving thread open for artifacts and RCA drafting.

eng-kevin: temporary patch rolled, will schedule full fix next sprint.

incident-bot: Incident P2 -> mitigated. Keep thread for post-incident RCA.
